summary: Learn BPMN, Lean Six Sigma, RPA screening, and KPI dashboards in 5 days. Build practical workflow improvements you can apply immediately.
lede: Process optimization and workflow automation give operations professionals a structured way to map work, locate bottlenecks, and plan realistic changes. Designed for process analysts, operations managers, and continuous-improvement leads, the course develops skills in BPMN and SIPOC mapping, root-cause and waste analysis, future-state workflow design, and screening tasks for RPA with exception handling and human oversight.
audienceIntro: This Workflow Automation and Process Optimization Training is designed for professionals who already work inside operational processes and now need to improve them with structure, evidence, and automation logic.
audience: Continuous Improvement Leads using Lean Six Sigma
modules: Value Stream Analysis and Waste Reduction
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of day-to-day business processes, basic spreadsheet use, and familiarity with at least one operational workflow in their role. No coding experience is required, although a willingness to work with process maps, KPI trackers, and simple automation logic will help you gain more from the hands-on exercises. For the digital exercises, you will need a laptop with spreadsheet software and access to common workflow or collaboration tools, depending on your organization’s setup. The course is designed at intermediate level, so prior exposure to process improvement, operations, or systems support is helpful but not mandatory.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
